_notice: FICTIONAL. Recovery objectives for Orrinwick Beacon. The numbers are a demo author's choice, not values set by FedRAMP (KSI-RPL-RRO says the provider defines and reviews its own).
strategy_summary: Multi-AZ production in us-east-1. AWS Backup takes recovery points every 2 hours and copies them to a locked, encrypted vault in us-west-2. No standing environment exists in us-west-2; Terraform builds one on demand from those recovery points.
